title: Enterprise Connectivity: port-hour price
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following port-hour price for each named contract tier. Dedicated interconnect port; USD per port-hour.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | port-hour price | 0.19 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | port-hour price | 0.29 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | port-hour price | 0.39 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | port-hour price | 0.49 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | port-hour price | 0.74 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | port-hour price | 1.24 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the port-hour price is 0.19.
